about: The frame budget of WORKLIST P0.112, written 2026-10-23 before its first measured run, no number taken from a measure of the screens it judges. The lab draws with a software GPU on which every frame is slow, so each line is stated against the control page measured in the same run (absolute where a principle gives one), with margins from published guidance. e2e/lab/scrolls.mjs (budgetOf) holds each busy screen to it; a screen over a line is over budget, its cause named by a lab arm and fixed. P2.5's budget file takes these over when it is made.

ready.reason: RAIL (web.dev): content within a second keeps the person's flow; the control carries the runner's own floor

jsOpen.reason: an opening reads and lays out a page; two tasks over 50 ms keep the first touch within RAIL's 100 ms response

jsScroll.reason: RAIL: a task over 50 ms delays the response to the next touch, and a scroll is a run of touches

slowUi.reason: a busy screen may cost more of the UI thread than plain rows, but not a tenth more of its frames

p90.reason: pictures and light cost something to draw, a quarter over the plain page, never a doubling
